title: Captive pin
request: Make a print-in-place pivot as two separate bodies. The first is a 30 x 20 x 20 mm block with an 8.6 mm hole straight through its 20 mm thickness, along the middle. The second is a pin with an 8 mm shaft that sits in that hole and a 12 mm wide, 2 mm thick head on each end, each head 0.4 mm clear of the block, so the pin is trapped but turns freely. The bodies must not touch.

needs.why: two bodies: cad_build passes them only with its bodies argument
